source_caption:
Boyz n the Hood follows Tre Styles, a teenager growing up in South Central Los Angeles, who is sent to live with his disciplined father in hopes of building a better future. As Tre and his friends navigate violence, poverty, peer pressure, and limited opportunities, they are forced to make life-altering choices that will shape their futures.

In Boyz n the Hood, the story blends crime, drama, and coming-of-age storytelling while exploring themes of family, friendship, responsibility, systemic inequality, and the consequences of violence. Written and directed by John Singleton, the film stars Cuba Gooding Jr., Ice Cube, Morris Chestnut, and Laurence Fishburne. It is widely regarded as a landmark film for its authentic portrayal of inner-city life and its lasting impact on American cinema.

source_details.synopsis: Boyz n the Hood is a 1991 American coming-of-age hood crime drama film, written and directed by John Singleton in his feature directorial debut. It stars Cuba Gooding Jr. and Laurence Fishburne, with Nia Long, Tyra Ferrell and Angela Bassett in supporting roles, and also marks the film debuts of Ice Cube, Morris Chestnut, and Regina King. Named after the 1987 Eazy-E song "The Boyz-n-the Hood", written by Ice Cube, the film follows Tre Styles (Gooding), who is sent to live with his father Furious Styles (Fishburne) in South Central Los Angeles, where he reunites with his childhood friends while being surrounded by the neighborhood's booming gang culture.
